items.title: DoJ requests beef price data from major retailers including Amazon and Walmart
items.summary: Investing.com -- The US Justice Department has expanded its antitrust investigation into the meatpacking industry by requesting information on beef prices from eight major food retailers.

items.title: Amazon, Walmart Face Data Requests in DOJ Beef Antitrust Probe
items.summary: The US Justice Department expanded its antitrust inquiry of the meatpacking industry by demanding information on surging beef prices from eight major food retailers, including Amazon.com Inc., Costco Wholesale Corp. and Walmart Inc.

items.title: Kroger taps Walmart tech veteran as store operations chief
items.summary: Mark Ibbotson, who helped lead the rollout of Walmart’s e-commerce platform, is the latest C-suite appointment for the supermarket chain.

items.title: 3 Consumer Stocks We Keep Off Our Radar
items.summary: Retailers are evolving to meet the expectations of modern, tech-savvy shoppers. Still, secular trends are working against them as e-commerce continues to take share from brick-and-mortar stores. This puts retail stocks in a tough spot, and over the past six months, the industry’s returns were flat while the S&P 500 gained 11.8%.

items.title: Dollar General and Dollar Tree send message to Kroger and Publix
items.summary: Value-conscious shoppers are changing where they buy everyday essentials, putting unexpected pressure on traditional grocers.

items.title: Grocery chain closes one of its last stores in major market
items.summary: The closure leaves the chain with just one store in the city.

items.title: Citi opens downside catalyst watch on Kroger as Walmart price war intensifies
items.summary: Investing.com -- Citi has opened a short-term downside catalyst watch on Kroger (NYSE: KR) ahead of second-quarter results on Sept. 11, warning that intensifying price competition from Walmart could pressure the grocer's comparable sales and margins.

items.title: Kroger shares fall 1.2% after Citi issues short-term downside watch
items.summary: Kroger (NYSE:KR) shares fell 1. 2% in pre-market trading after Citi placed the supermarket group on a short-term downside Catalyst Watch ahead of its second-quarter 2026 earnings report.
